title: Unify bounded MSBuild semantic evaluation for C# and F#
outcome: A single bounded MSBuild semantic evaluation core is generalized from the F# implementation and then adopted deliberately by C# semantics without changing conservative index ownership.
acceptance: C# and F# semantic paths consume the shared evaluated model without changing the conservative compile-ownership parser.
One shared bounded evaluator owns property expansion, imports, conditions, Choose, reserved project/current-document directories, and the declared safe function allowlist.
Parity tests prove shared props and conditions select equivalent compiler-affecting facts for C# and F#.
Release build, complete tests, external MCP gate, website verification, and one dual review round pass.
The shared evaluator supports the required TargetFramework.StartsWith condition and workspace-contained indexed Exists paths while unsupported functions and paths outside the workspace fail closed.
